name: Mosa Industrial Corporation
summary: Mosa Industrial Corporation specializes in the global production and distribution of a wide range of goods for both industrial and individual consumers. Its industrial segment features various inflator types, including those designed for driver-side dual-stage deployment, passenger-side airbags, and curtain safety systems. On the consumer front, the company supplies products such as UBar items, cream whippers, siphons, equipment for tire inflation, and diverse charging units. Established in 1988, Mosa Industrial Corporation maintains its headquarters in Yunlin, Taiwan.
